records.description:
Another Free creative coding tool. I guess 2026 is going to be the year of Design that doesn’t make sense, but is fun to make. 

I developed this fairly simple script to track my hands from my webcam. I can set any word (10 characters max) and move it around my screen, besides that I started playing with a reactive background sequence - the background changes based on the movement of the hands.

Try it yourself at web.kevinhipke.com/camtrack
